R. s. 40</cite> (play on <cite ref="M02663"><he>מֹרִיָּה</he></cite>) <he>ארץ שמָרוּתוֹ … בתוכה</he> (not <he>לתוכה</he>) the district in which the lordship of the world resides; <he>ואף המקום מ׳ הוא על וכ׳</he> and the place, too, is the ruler of all other places (ref. to <he>בעלתה</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 13:6">I Chr. <cite ref="Berakhot 48a:5">Ber. 48ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>קא חזית דלא מקבלי מ׳</he> you see that they (the Pharisees) recognize no (royal) authority.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:5">Sabb. 106ᵇ</cite> (v. <cite ref="D01075"><he>דְּרוֹר</he></cite>) <he>שאינה מקבלה מ׳</he> it does not submit to domestication.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 1:4">Tosef. B. Kam. I, 4</cite> <he>אם היו מ׳</he> Var. in ed. Zuck. (sub. <he>של</he>; ed. <cite ref="M02588"><he>מרום</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02599"><he>מרוס</he></cite>; ed. Zuck. <cite ref="V00927"><he>תַּרְבּוּת</he></cite>) if they (the animals) were domesticated, opp. <he>באו מן המדבר</he>.
